evidence: ALD is carried out using bis(2,2,6,6-tetramethyl-3,5-heptanedionato)copper(II) and hydrogen to deposit ALD copper films. The solid copper precursor is evaporated from a bubbler controlled to 124 °C, and argon is used as the carrier gas. Argon is also used as the purge gas and its flow is controlled with a proportional-integral-derivate controller to maintain a chamber pressure of 1 torr.
